title: AppArmor: refresh the kept distro profile after an apparmor update
objective:
Molt keeps Ubuntu's AppArmor profile for bwrap in `/var/lib/molt/apparmor`, and never refreshes that copy after an apparmor package update. Refresh it when the package changes. Also fix the comment in `templates/apparmor/bwrap-userns-restrict.tmpl`, which says the copy is kept beside the profile.

Source: wip.md's carried list of October; the doc sync of 27 Nov.
